title: Maison Ikkoku
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Poor, weak-willed student Yusaku Godai lives in a run-down Tokyo boarding house with eccentric, meddling tenants and falls for the young widowed manager, Kyoko Otonashi. Over years of misunderstandings and a rivalry with wealthy tennis coach Mitaka, Godai grows up, gets a job, and he and Kyoko marry and have a daughter.
life_message: Patient, faithful love and growing into responsibility lead to a lasting marriage, even after grief.

content.note: Slapstick and a slap from Kyoko (Wikipedia).
Peeping tenant, libertine Akemi, a love-hotel misunderstanding, the couple consummate before marriage (Wikipedia); MU Nudity.
Alcoholic gossip Mrs. Ichinose, boozy bar hostess Akemi and tenant drinking parties (Viz blurb; Wikipedia).
Reviewer praises its portrayal of the slow grieving process (Wikipedia reception).
Tenants mooch, peep and meddle as comedy.

dominant: Romance toward marriage; maturing into responsibility; grief and fidelity
